title: Build scope-guard running-line watcher (T1–T5 flags and pauses)
summary: Retry of the failed job: after each attempt of a line, evaluate T1–T5 from scope_guard.rs, record flags and pause records (signal, numbers, lift condition), show them in athena status, and make dispatch and athena retry refuse a paused line. Audience is the owner running Athena. Demonstrations must use states the code accepts (not a Dispatched job to go; a real positive p90 for T3).

defaults_applied.how: New tests for watcher, dispatch refusal, retry refusal, and status; cargo test and clippy clean.
Tests include controls that dispatch without the pause and fail if the guard is removed.
Criteria check that the third attempt is not dispatched and status shows the signal.
One focused change on the existing T1–T5 evaluators.
Docs, changelog and design entry written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: stop thrashing lines of work without killing any process; the owner sees flags and pauses in athena status.
reading.rs gets a single-call edit so Athena::retry refuses a paused line; it is now a deliverable.
Pause files are keyed by the line's first job id; refuse_if_paused rebuilds RequestRecords and calls group_lines for the job being dispatched, then looks up the pause by the line head id.
T3's forecast p90 dollars is read from the job's existing forecast record and passed to t3_cost, so T3 can pause.
The third linked request in the two-rejection test is made with ask('try again on <id>'), not retry; the same setup without the pause file dispatches (control).
The never-kills test starts a real child process (e.g. sleep) registered as the line's running job, drives the watcher to a Pause, and asserts the child is alive and the registry entry unchanged.
Each demonstration test is checked against the guards on its path (go refuses Dispatched; t3_cost needs p90 > 0) before being written.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test with two rejections on the same unmet criterion, with the third request made via ask('try again on <id>'), shows the third attempt is not dispatched and a pause record exists; a control with no pause file dispatches. Run cargo test.
A test with rejections on differing criteria records a flag only: no pause record and the next attempt is dispatched. Run cargo test.
A test shows athena retry on a paused line refuses with the pause reason, and dispatch finds the line head via group_lines. Run cargo test.
A T3 test passing a real positive forecast p90 from the job's record pauses the line, and fails if the pause is removed. Run cargo test.
A test registers a real child process as a line's running job, drives the watcher to a Pause, and asserts the child is still alive and the registry entry unchanged. Run cargo test.
A test shows athena status output lists flagged and paused lines with their signal (T1–T5). Run cargo test.
A pause record names the signal, the numbers that tripped it, and what would lift it (a measurement, or a narrowed request for T4).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the watcher, and docs/design/scope-guard.md reflects job 5 and the p90 source.
cargo clippy is clean and cargo fmt --check passes.

out_of_scope: Changing T1–T5 thresholds or evaluators beyond wiring
Governance files such as athena.toml or defaults.toml
departures: Larger than reference: multi-file change across five crates files with several non-trivial tests; prior attempt failed in planning.
